sections.content: Personality words follow the same predicate pattern as physical description: Ő kedves (He is kind), Ők kedvesek (They are kind).
sections.title: Character words

sections.content: csendes and hangos are natural opposites — pairing a new adjective with its opposite, like magas/alacsony or öreg/fiatal earlier, is a fast way to double your vocabulary for free.

vicces actually comes from vicc (a joke) plus -s. Adding -s (or -es/-os/-as, chosen by vowel harmony) to a noun is one of the most common ways Hungarian builds adjectives — kedves works the same way. So a word ending in -s is often an adjective built from a noun you may already know.
